```{r}
z <- (6.5 - 5.6) / (2.1 / sqrt(n))
```

```{r}
p.value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(z))
```

## 2 Sided Confidence Interval

```{r}
mu0 <- 5.6
xbar <- 6.5
sigma <- 2.1
n <- 50
se <- 2.1 / sqrt(n)
alpha <- 0.01
z <- (xbar - mu0) / (se / sqrt(n))
```

```{r}
z.star <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)
ME <- z.star * se
(CI <- c(xbar - ME, xbar + ME))
```

```{r}
(p.value <- 1 - pnorm(z))
```

## 1 Sided Upper Confidence Interval

```{r}
z.star <- qnorm(1 - alpha)
ME <- z.star * se
(CI <- c(xbar - ME, Inf))
```
